entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: Papyrus 79 is a copy of the New Testament in Greek. It is a papyrus manuscript of the Epistle to the Hebrews. It is designated by the siglum 𝔓79 in the Gregory-Aland numbering of New Testament manuscripts. The surviving text of Hebrews are verses 10:10-12,28-30. Papyrus 79 is a manuscript. Classified as Tier A (Primary Source) evidence. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
